body:
S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term. This signals increasing optimism among investors and indicates continued rise. It also gave positive signal from the rectangle formation at the break up through the resistance at 7594. Further rise to 7833 or more is signaled. The index has broken up through resistance at points 7600. This predicts a further rise. The index is overall assessed as technically positive for the medium long term.
